note: One example = a 2–3 minute window of one bout: sentence-level commentary ASR with word times and a 3-way class (1 play-by-play, 2 tactical, 3 contextual, per the repo training script), plus automatically detected punch events (frames at 30 fps) and the round boundaries (column names in Chinese: 第一回合开始 = round 1 start, etc.). The timeline shows only effective punches and fouls; the raw keeps up to 30 events of every kind. Videos are Eurovision Sport broadcasts not redistributed, so no clip.
